notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Elemental has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, targeting Incubation Druid.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Incubation Druid's second ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, targeting Locust Swarm.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Locust Swarm's second ability by paying {G}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
